mapper.select: SELECT a.cd_grop_cd AS cd_group, /* 코드그룹 */ a.cd_grop_cd_nm AS cd_group_nm, /* 코드그룹명 */ a.cd_grop_rmrk AS rmrk_cn, /* 비고내용 */ a.use_yn, /* 사용여부 */ a.cd_pcus_cd AS cd_plcus_cd, /* 코드사용처코드 */ (SELECT s.cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd s WHERE s.cd_grop_cd = 'CD_PLCUS_CD' AND s.cmmn_cd = a.cd_pcus_cd AND s.lcal_cd = #{locale}) AS cd_plcus_cd_nm, /* 코드사용처코드명 */ a.sys_reg_usr_id AS rgtr_id, /* 등록자ID */ (SELECT s.usr_nm FROM cdm_own.usr s WHERE s.usr_id = a.sys_reg_usr_id) AS rgtr_id_nm, /* 등록자명 */ a.sys_reg_dttm AS reg_dt, /* 등록일시 */ a.sys_chg_usr_id AS mdfr_id, /* 수정자ID */ (SELECT s.usr_nm FROM cdm_own.usr s WHERE s.usr_id = a.sys_chg_usr_id) AS mdfr_id_nm, /* 수정자명 */ a.sys_chg_dttm AS mdfcn_dt /* 수정일시 */ FROM cdm_own.cd_grop a /* 코드그룹 */ WHERE a.cd_grop_cd = #{cdGroup}

SELECT a.cmmn_cd AS cd, /* 코드 */ a.cd_grop_cd AS cd_group, /* 코드그룹 */ a.lcal_cd AS locale, /* 로케일 */ a.cmmn_cd_nm AS cd_nm, /* 코드명 */ a.cd_dvcd AS cd_se, /* 코드구분 */ a.use_yn, /* 사용여부 */ a.sort_seq AS sort_sn, /* 정렬일련번호 */ a.sys_reg_usr_id AS rgtr_id, /* 등록자ID */ (SELECT s.usr_nm FROM cdm_own.usr s WHERE s.usr_id = a.sys_reg_usr_id) AS rgtr_id_nm, /* 등록자명 */ a.sys_reg_dttm AS reg_dt, /* 등록일시 */ a.sys_chg_usr_id AS mdfr_id, /* 수정자ID */ (SELECT s.usr_nm FROM cdm_own.usr s WHERE s.usr_id = a.sys_chg_usr_id) AS mdfr_id_nm, /* 수정자명 */ a.sys_chg_dttm AS mdfcn_dt /* 수정일시 */ FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd a /* 코드 */ WHERE a.cd_grop_cd = #{cdGroup} AND a.cmmn_cd = #{cd}
AND a.lcal_cd = #{locale}

SELECT a.cmmn_cd AS cd, /* 코드 */ a.cd_grop_cd AS cd_group, /* 코드그룹 */ a.lcal_cd AS locale, /* 로케일 */ a.ref_cd AS rfrnc_cd, /* 참조코드 */ a.ref_cd_nm AS rfrnc_nm, /* 참조명 */ a.ref_vlu AS rfrnc_vl /* 참조값 */ FROM cdm_own.ref_cd a /* 참조코드 */ WHERE a.cd_grop_cd = #{cdGroup} AND a.cmmn_cd = #{cd}
AND a.lcal_cd = #{locale}
